- Homework 4
  - `lower.tail = T` vs `lower.tail = F`
    - In `p____()` (like `pbinom()`)...
        - `lower.tail=T` gives us $P(X \leq q)$ 
        - `lower.tail=F` gives us $P(X > q)$
